exposure: family structure (living in an extended family)
cohort: The study included 326 hospitalized women with high-risk pregnancies.
finding: COVID-19 anxiety and obsession levels are positively correlated with increased fear of childbirth in women with high-risk pregnancies.
mod_finding: Women scheduled for vaginal delivery were 1.80 times more likely to experience fear of childbirth (FOBS2) than those scheduled for a caesarean section.
